title: Check total size of specific file types
summary: Use `du` with a wildcard to calculate the total disk space used by files matching a specific pattern (like all .jpg files) in the current directory and its subdirectories.

aliases.text: size of all jpg files mac

steps.explain: Run `du -ch` followed by a wildcard pattern (e.g., `*/*.jpg`) to list sizes of matching files and show a cumulative total at the end.

placeholders.name: PATTERN
placeholders.description: A wildcard pattern for the files you want to measure, e.g., `*/*.jpg` for all JPGs in subdirectories.
